title: Formalize the $\infty/\infty$ form of L'Hopital's rule in Lean — Mathlib curr...

problemStatement.formal: If g tends to infinity and f'/g' tends to c in a limit direction, then f/g tends to c; the local development records right, left, atTop, and atBot variants.
problemStatement.plain: Formalizes the infinity/infinity form of L'Hopital's rule in Lean, complementing Mathlib's existing zero-over-zero variants.
whyMatters: Fills a calculus-library gap around infinity-over-infinity indeterminate forms.
Shows the two-variable Cauchy mean value theorem argument needed when the functions diverge at the limit point.
Provides reusable right, left, atTop, and atBot statements for future limit formalizations.

proven: proofs/Proofs/LHopitalOQ02.lean contains the completed right-approach theorem plus left, atTop, and atBot variants.
The main Lean file records 428 lines, 5 theorem declarations including the private c = 0 engine, and no occurrences of sorry or axiom.
The proof reduces the general constant case to c = 0 and controls the correction terms with a two-variable Cauchy mean value theorem argument.
open: The companion Aristotle sketch file still contains 3 sorries and should not be treated as the completed proof artifact.
Upstream Mathlib integration remains separate; this repository records the local formalization surface.
knownResults.goal: Keep the research problem metadata aligned with the completed local L'Hopital infinity-over-infinity formalization.

currentState.nextAction: Read problem.md thoroughly and acquire full context.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: All 4 variants of ∞/∞ LHopital proved (0 sorries, 0 axioms). Docker-verified. Fixed 7 pre-existing Mathlib API breakages in the right-approach proof.
builtItems: lhopital_infty_right_zero: c=0 case, full proof (~100 lines)
lhopital_infty_right: general case via c=0 reduction (~20 lines)
lhopital_infty_left: left approach via negation reduction (~27 lines)
lhopital_infty_atTop: atTop via inversion reduction (~32 lines)
lhopital_infty_atBot: atBot via negation of atTop (~22 lines)
insights: Mathlib has 26 L Hopital variants but ALL are 0/0 form — genuine gap for infinity/infinity
Only g → ∞ needed (not both f and g), making this more general than naive 1/f 1/g reduction
Proof requires two-variable Cauchy MVT: fix x0, let x → a, then optimize x0
Four sorries: main proof + 3 reductions (left via negation, atTop via 1/x, atBot via -x)

Proof structure for lhopital_infty_right fully mapped: Cauchy MVT application on [x,x₀] gives ratio, algebraic decomposition gives bound, g→∞ controls correction terms. Key Mathlib APIs: exists_ratio_hasDerivAt_eq_ratio_slope, Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds, Filter.Tendsto.eventually_ge_atTop

Main barrier: converting between Filter.Eventually on 𝓝[>]a and delta-neighborhoods requires careful API navigation (eventually_nhdsWithin_iff, Metric.eventually_nhds_iff). Needs iterative REPL debugging.
c=0 reduction is key: define h=f-cg, prove h/g→0, then f/g=h/g+c→c
For c=0 case: Cauchy MVT gives f(x)/g(x) = R·(1-g(x₀)/g(x)) + f(x₀)/g(x), bound each term by ε/2
Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff extracts delta from filter eventually for g→∞
g(x)>g(x₀) gives both g(x)≠g(x₀) and 0≤1-g(x₀)/g(x)≤1 without Rolle argument
Mathlib 0/0 LHopital reductions pattern (negation/inversion/compose-back) transfers directly to ∞/∞ case

Pre-existing proof had 7 Mathlib API breakages: Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff type change, Ioo_mem_nhdsWithin_Ioi→Ioo_mem_nhdsGT, dist_zero_right now gives norm not abs, abs_add→abs_add_le, div_lt_div_iff→div_lt_div_iff₀, abs_div rewrite order sensitivity, nlinarith needs explicit div_mul_cancel for division
nextSteps: Docker-verify the proof when Docker is available
Prove lhopital_infty_atBot via u=-x reduction to atTop
